Class AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassSettings

java.lang.Object
com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.DefaultSettingsProvider
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.DarkJediTermSettings

All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.SettingsProvider, com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.SystemSettingsProvider, com.jediterm.terminal.ui.settings.UserSettingsProvider
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private final class AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassSettings extends DarkJediTermSettings
The class MoodGlassSettings is the settings copy for the mood glass. The mood glass is the private terminal pane for the mood dialog. Type-ahead stays off so the glass echoes once. The live terminal keeps its own settings object. A caller builds this object with the constructor. getTypeAheadSettings() is the object the glass reads. The type refuses the inherited type-ahead settings.

    • getTypeAheadSettings

      public com.jediterm.terminal.model.TerminalTypeAheadSettings getTypeAheadSettings()
      The method returns type-ahead settings with the feature off. The latency is 0. The style is the default type-ahead style. The glass uses this object instead of the live terminal settings.
